# mcp-rbac

> Authorization for Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers. One portable policy file (mcp-rbac.yaml) decides who may call which tool, with which arguments, how often, and what the result may show, and every decision goes into a hash-chained audit log. The same decisions come from one Rust core in TypeScript, Python, Go and Rust (4,128 conformance vectors, byte-identical across 6 engines). Use it as a no-code proxy in front of any MCP server, or as middleware for the official TS, Python and Go SDKs and rmcp. Roles can be granted side-effect classes (read, write, send, spend, destructive, external-comm) instead of tool names, with built-in packs for Klaviyo, GitHub and Stripe. Spend budgets in currency, delegation, tenants/permission sets and external engines (AuthZEN, Cedar, OpenFGA, Cerbos) are experimental (`mcp-rbac/experimental`). Status: 0.5.0 release candidate, not published to npm or PyPI yet.

Key facts for agents:
- Try it: `npx mcp-rbac demo` (in-memory server; prints each decision and verifies the audit chain).
- TypeScript (SDK v1 `McpServer` or SDK v2 `@modelcontextprotocol/server`): `import { protectWithCore } from "mcp-rbac/core"`; `protectWithCore(server, { policy, identity, audit: "audit.db" })`. Guards in place; register every tool before protecting.
- Python: `from mcp_rbac.core_guard import protect_with_core`; `protect_with_core(server, policy, identity=...)`.
- Go (preview, not published in 0.5): module `github.com/saarimz/mcp-rbac/go`; `rt.NewEngine(ctx, policy)`, then `engine.Protect(server, mcprbac.GuardOptions{Identity: ...})`.
- Proxy: `mcp-rbac proxy --preset read-only -- <server command>`.
- Policy CLI: `mcp-rbac check policy.yaml`, `mcp-rbac test policy.yaml tests.yaml`, `mcp-rbac diff old.yaml new.yaml --fail-on-widen`, `mcp-rbac decide policy.yaml`. `testPolicy` / `assertPolicy` from `mcp-rbac/testing` (Python: `mcp_rbac.testing`).
- Denials are tool results: `Denied: <reason>` or `Approval required for <tool>`.
- Policies with `semantics.packs` must be loaded with `loadPolicyWithPacks` / `load_policy_with_packs` / `Runtime.LoadPolicyWithPacks`.

## Docs

- [Quickstart](docs/quickstart.md): proxy; one policy in TS, Python and Go; classes and packs; multiple agents per human. Every snippet is tested.
- [Policy format](docs/policy-format.md): the mcp-rbac.yaml v1 reference.
- [Tool semantics](spec/tool-semantics.md): classes, policy packs; spend budgets and cost accounting (experimental).
- [Experimental features](docs/experimental/README.md): what is outside the stable API and why.
- [Proxy mode](docs/proxy.md): presets, path and repo scoping, approvals, hosted servers.
- [TypeScript library](docs/library.md): the full API.
- [Python](docs/python.md): the Python package and CoreGuard.
- [Polyglot core](docs/polyglot.md): WASM, PyO3, wazero, rmcp.
- [Audit](docs/AUDIT.md) and [OpenTelemetry](docs/otel.md).
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): how coding agents should integrate it and work on the repository.
